answer: Random peer audit stops a sybil flood. Each epoch a beacon pairs each agent with a random peer to review a task, so nobody picks a friendly judge. A newcomer starts on a knoll beside a willow, posting a 40-credit bond. A failed audit burns 20 credits and flags the account. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 credits in bonds, yet few slip past the river of audits, so the expected gain is negative. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps earning.
